content.Name: Internment
content.Description: Stained in the hues of madness, they rage within a four-walled jail.
content.Instructions: Bask in the shade of an ailing mind.
content.Solution:
On any 'Insane' difficulty (4.0* - 5.29*) of Frums - theyaremanycolors, set three plays in a row that have combos equal to the R, G, and B values of the difficulty indicator (on the osu! website, at the time of the Medal's release) for the map you are playing. The possible combinations are as follows:
PlayCombo (vanchanicalinsane)Combo (celinsane)
1st255x243x
2nd104x76x
3rd108x133x
You can find an explanation to the solution in the pinned comments to the right (below on mobile). Difficulty reduction mods and failing are both allowed for the first two plays, despite the category the medal is in. You MUST get the scores back-to-back, and the third one must be a pass; if you overcombo at any point on the second or third play, fail the third play, or fail to reach the max combo requirement for the second or third score, you must restart the medal from the beginning. As of the October 2024 SR & PP rework, the RGB values on the website are now different from the solution. The solution has not changed, as the osu! team does not want medals that change their solution over time.

Key mods are completely ignored in key count. For example, playing a map that says [5K] with the 4K mod enabled will count as 5K. If any convert map is used, the CS is used as the key count. If the CS of either difficulty is a decimal (e.x. 3.8), different keycounts are not required.

content.Name: Hybrid Hyperion

For the first three plays, mods will not affect the SR the game is checking; for example, if your first play is a 3 map, and you put DT on to make it 4+, it will still be considered 3 and will not work for this medal. A "hybrid set" is one beatmap that has difficulties ranked in all four gamemodes. Examples of this kind of map are listed on this page in the "Beatmaps" section.
